name: order-stages
title: Order Stages
description: An order on its way: a glowing track runs to a knob showing the stage under way, chips for what comes next.

perf.budget: Knob and track use UI-thread springs on change. A sheen loops along the track as one view, so it animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The knob jumps to its place, does not swell, the sheen stops and the minutes do not count.
a11y.screenReader: One progress bar ("21 minutes left. COOKING. Nº 27") with the stage number.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { OrderStages } from '@/components/kinetik/order-stages';

<OrderStages
  stages={[
    { label: 'COOKING', icon: 'cook' },
    { label: 'PACKING', icon: 'pack' },
    { label: 'ON THE WAY', icon: 'ride' },
    { label: 'DELIVERED', icon: 'check' },
  ]}
  current={0}
  minutesLeft={21}
  order="Nº 27"
/>;
```

## When to use

- Food, parcel and ride tracking with three to five clear stages.
- A live activity style widget.

## When not to use

- Many stages: the chips run out of room past about five.
- When there is no time estimate. Use Step Tracker.

## Notes

- Icons are `cook`, `pack`, `ride` and `check`.
- Finished stages disappear into the track.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add order-stages`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
